messages:
sanjay: Quick share — ran the bring-up eval for rwd-llama-13b variants (FP8, GPTQ-4bit, AWQ-8bit) against Goldenset v2 (prod-like multi-turn prompts). Results below.

sanjay: ```
Model    | EM delta | avg_latency_ms | token_cost %
FP8      | +0.0     | 120            | baseline
GPTQ-4   | -0.6     | 95             | -28%
AWQ-8    | -1.7     | 88             | -35%
```

lena: AWQ latency win is nice but -1.7 EM is worrying on our QA sets. How many samples in Goldenset v2 and distribution?

sanjay: Goldenset v2 = 2.4k prompts, weighted toward multi-turn code, math and reference resolution. Regression mass is concentrated in MATH + code-refactor style prompts (~78% of observed deltas).

kevin: For rollout propose profile-based canary: hosted 0.5% traffic AWQ, dedicated 3%, private 0% until we fix regressions. Gating rules: EM delta threshold = -1.0 ppt, and regression_fraction_on_goldenset < 0.4. Circuit breaker: user-visible error rate > 0.5% OR sudden 10x spike in helpdesk tickets.

nina: What's the automatic fallback/rollback plan? We need to avoid visible hallucination or correctness regressions in production.

sanjay: Fallback plan: auto-route to FP8 variant if goldenset_pass_rate < 98% OR EM_delta <= -1.0 ppt. Manual override available: `rctl rollout abort --policy quant-fallback --to model:fp8`. Also logging will include per-prompt category tags for triage.

deploy-bot: Deployment check: canary config validated. Streaming metrics: `eval.delta_em`, `latency.p50`, `inference.errors`, `regen_requests`. Will emit alerts to #incidents if any threshold breached.

lena: Add one more gate: if >50% of regressions come from a single category (e.g., math or code), hold rollout and create targeted prompt subset for diagnostics.

kevin: SRE asks for gradual ramp: 0.5% -> 2% -> 5% over 24h windows, manual signoff between steps. Also add a 10-minute cooldown window after any metric spike before next ramp.

nina: Product note: during the canary surface an opt-in UI flag that marks the experience as 'latency-optimized' for sampled users and collect a tiny qualitative NPS/feedback snippet. Helps detect regressions not visible in EM.

sanjay: :thumbsup: I'll open a PR with quant-tweaks (per-layer clipping + fp16 fastpath for attention kernels) and re-run Goldenset. ETA ~24h.

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall is paged for canary window 2025-09-15T10:00Z - 2025-09-16T10:00Z.

kevin: I'll add the routing rule now: `route-policy create quant-canary --model awq-8 --traffic 0.5 --fallback fp8 --gates 'golden_em_delta>-1.0'` — will post the policy ID once created.

nina: Thanks team. Keep notes on evasive prompt cases and assemble rollback comms (short script for customer support).

sanjay: Will do. I'll ping when Goldenset re-run completes and include per-category diffs + example failing prompts for triage.
